items.title: 1.9 Period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein bonding ke rujhan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.9, printed page 16.

blocks.text: Groups 1, 2 aur 3 ke oxides, maslan Na2O, zyada ionic kirdar rakhte hain: yeh mukhalif charge wale ions ke darmiyan mazboot electrostatic quwwaton wale bare (giant) ionic lattices ke taur par maujood hain. Groups 4 se 7 ke oxides, maslan SO2, zyada covalent hain aur kamzor bain-molecular (intermolecular) quwwaton wale covalent molecules ke taur par maujood hain. Yeh tabdeeli period ke saath barhti electronegativity aur ghat'te ionic kirdar ka nateeja hai.

Isi tarah groups 1, 2 aur 3 ke chlorides, maslan NaCl, zyada tar ionic hain, jab ke groups 4 se 7 ke anasir ke chlorides, maslan PCl5, covalent hain. Chlorides ka covalent kirdar is liye barhta hai ke halogen aur doosre atom ke darmiyan electronegativity ka farq ghat'ta hai.

blocks.caption: Period 3 mein bonding
rows: Ionic: giant lattices, mazboot electrostatic quwwatein (Na2O)
O ya Cl se bara electronegativity farq
Electronegativity barhne se farq sukarta hai

blocks.prompt: Sodium oxide bohat zyada darja-hararat par pighalta hai jab ke sulfur dioxide kamre ke darja-hararat par gas hai. Is ka har ek ki bonding se taalluq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sodium oxide ions ke darmiyan mazboot electrostatic quwwaton se jura giant ionic lattice hai, jise torne mein bohat tawanai lagti hai. Sulfur dioxide covalent molecules ka bana hai jo ek doosre se sirf kamzor intermolecular quwwaton se jure hain, to yeh gas hai.

items: Na, Mg aur Al ke oxides aur chlorides ionic (giant lattices) hain; Si, P, S aur Cl ke covalent molecules, kyunke oxygen ya chlorine se electronegativity ka farq period ke saath girta hai.
